admit.timestamps: monotonic CFR; reject missing, negative, duplicate, discontinuous or VFR timestamps
admit.audioSelection: first default audio track, else lowest stream index; reject >8 channels; downmix with fixed FFmpeg stereo matrix; synthesize silence if absent

normalization: Probe full source, then seek by authoritative source-frame index and normalize only the half-open four-second interval; never transcode the entire five-minute source. The worker substitutes only numeric frame/time values, admitted transfer, source fps, and the selected audio stream index. Channel mapping is deterministic: mono duplicates channel 0, stereo uses channels 0 and 1, 3+ channels downmix with FFmpeg pan coefficients FL=1.0*FL+0.707*FC+0.707*BL+0.5*LFE and FR=1.0*FR+0.707*FC+0.707*BR+0.5*LFE; absent audio uses the silence source template.
cameraUnits: translation px/frame; rotation deg/frame; multiplicative scale/frame; px/ms = px/frame * fps / 1000
fallbackThresholdRule: Only absolute analysis-pixel tolerances change: centroid 3.0px, camera translation 1.5px/frame, defocus sigma 1.5px. Every ratio, IoU, token, angular, scale, depth, audio and normalized-error threshold remains identical to primary.
